title: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Films
blurb: Two anime films that each belong to a different TV series, and a live-action trilogy that retells the story from scratch.

fma05.t: Fullmetal Alchemist the Movie: Conqueror of Shamballa

fma11.t: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Sacred Star of Milos

fma22a.t: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar

groups.title: The 2003 anime's finale
groups.note: Follows the final episode of the 2003 series.

groups.title: A Brotherhood side story
groups.note: Set during Brotherhood, around its first third.

note: Conqueror of Shamballa is the ending of the 2003 anime and makes no sense without it. The Sacred Star of Milos is a side story that slots into the middle of Brotherhood. The live-action trilogy stands alone.
